optional_valid: Visually distinguishing the myth share from the two reality shares.

unsupported_to_avoid: Adding the first-year and three-year reality shares together.

Deriving a complement or remainder not stated in the data.

No cross-panel or multi-ring structure is present; all rows share the same panel and series scope.
Labels are approximate for the reality rates, so accept variants that preserve the approximate qualifier.
